subject: music
title: Songs & Performance
welcome_lead: Diction, expression and connecting with an audience.
meta_desc: KS3 voice: diction, expression, microphone basics.
final_note: Singing is half technique, half communication.

concepts.def: Device that picks up and amplifies voice.

walkthroughs.body_html: Diction means singing words clearly so the audience understands. Crisp consonants and full vowels matter. Mumbled words = lost message.
Expression brings a song alive. Think about the lyric meaning. A sad line needs softer tone; a defiant line needs strength.
Hold a mic about 5-10 cm from your mouth. On loud notes, pull it back to avoid distortion (peaking). Lean in for quiet moments.
